company.shortDescription: BeGo operates a digital platform that connects shippers and carriers and provides freight, tracking, and fleet management services.
company.description: BeGo operates a digital logistics platform that connects freight with available transport for shippers and carriers. The company provides tools to request and manage road and maritime cargo services, track shipments, and handle documentation in the cloud. Its marketplace helps transport operators find nearby loads, increase utilization, and reduce empty returns. BeGo offers BeGo Black, a fleet management software that supports cost control and real-time monitoring of vehicles and commercial teams. The company also supports customs brokerage activities and integrates cargo status visibility across services. Through BeGoPru, developed with an insurance partner, it offers integrated insurance products tailored to cargo transport operators.
